title: Apply for a motor dealer licence
summary: Learn about and apply for a motor dealer licence if your business buys, sells, or exchanges motor vehicles.
intro:
If your business includes the buying, selling or exchanging of motor vehicles, including cars, trailers, motorcycles and caravans, you'll need a motor dealer licence. This includes online motor dealers offering for sale and selling motor vehicles on their website.

You can apply online for an individual or corporation licence. You can choose a 1-year, 3-year or 5-year licence.

Note: Licensed motor dealers selling vehicles wholly or partly online must now notify NSW Fair Trading that they're an online dealer.
who_can_apply: Be at least 18 years of age.
Be considered fit and proper for the licence (NSW Fair Trading checks police records).
Not be disqualified from holding a licence due to disciplinary action.
Not be a controlled member of a declared organisation.
Not have been found guilty of a motor vehicle stealing offence in the past 10 years.
Have sufficient financial resources to run the business as required by Fair Trading.
Have approval from the relevant local council for physical notified premises.
what_you_need: Personal details (name, address, and date of birth) for the individual or business partners.
Business details, including the registered name, address, and incorporation date.
Australian Company Number (ACN) or Australian Business Number (ABN).
A completed Manager's Consent Form (if employing a business manager).

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for your licence.
Download and complete the relevant PDF form:
Submit your application with payment at a Service NSW Centre.

more_info.text: A corporation must nominate an individual to be manager of the day-to-day business of the licensee. An individual may manage the business themselves or nominate another individual to manage the business.
Once you're licensed as a motor dealer you must display your licence name and number at your place of business and publish them on any advertising or promotional material.

faqs.q: What types of vehicles require a motor dealer licence?
faqs.a: A licence is needed if your business involves buying, selling, or exchanging motor vehicles, including cars, trailers, motorcycles, and caravans. This also applies to online dealers selling vehicles on their website.
You can apply for a licence that lasts for 1, 3, or 5 years.

faqs.q: Do I need to notify NSW Fair Trading if I sell online?
faqs.a: Yes, licensed motor dealers selling vehicles wholly or partly online must notify NSW Fair Trading that they are an online dealer.
